title: fix: spell out RPM in model tooltip
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Writes out “requests per minute” in the per-user rate-limit tooltip.
- Keeps the compact `RPM/user` chip label unchanged.

Checks:
- Biome
- `git diff --check`

gist.headline: RPM Gets Its Full Name
gist.blurb: The tiny rate-limit tooltip now introduces itself properly. The chip stays compact; the explanation does the talking.
gist.summary: Expanded the per-user rate-limit tooltip from the abbreviation RPM to “requests per minute” while keeping the visible `RPM/user` chip unchanged.
gist.impact: Users inspecting model limits now get a clearer explanation of the per-user request rate without losing the compact status-chip layout.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a patient little librarian or teacher beside a retro model-status board: a small `RPM/user` chip points to a larger friendly tooltip reading “requests per minute.” Add tiny code-plants and flowers to make the clarification feel like a label growing into useful information.
